## 2026 JIDS article

The data and R scripts below reproduce every table, figure, and in-text statistic in the article. Variables are described in the [codebook](codebook.qmd).

### 2026 JIDS data

Archived on Harvard Dataverse: [doi:10.7910/DVN/EGOICA](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/EGOICA)

| Dataset | Unit | Rows | Download |
|---|---|---|---|
| `isaac_cases` | Arbitration | 1,229 | [CSV](data/2026_jids/isaac_cases.csv) · [Stata](data/2026_jids/isaac_cases.dta) · [R](data/2026_jids/isaac_cases.rds) · [Excel](data/2026_jids/isaac_cases.xlsx) |
| `isaac_redactions` | Arbitration with public documents | 874 | [CSV](data/2026_jids/isaac_redactions.csv) · [Stata](data/2026_jids/isaac_redactions.dta) · [R](data/2026_jids/isaac_redactions.rds) · [Excel](data/2026_jids/isaac_redactions.xlsx) |
| `unctad_awards_2023` | UNCTAD case, 31 December 2023 release | 1,332 | [CSV](data/2026_jids/unctad_awards_2023.csv) · [Stata](data/2026_jids/unctad_awards_2023.dta) · [R](data/2026_jids/unctad_awards_2023.rds) · [Excel](data/2026_jids/unctad_awards_2023.xlsx) |

### 2026 JIDS scripts
